Quick if you buy the items; weeks if you collect the tokens in the Bigfoot's Burden Quest

The **Soil Guardian** outfit and its two addons are obtained using three gnomish vouchers: the one for the base outfit and the one for the first addon are swapped for {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major} and {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} with {npc:Gnomally} in Gnomegate; the one for the second addon drops, with a bit of luck, from {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages}. You also get the achievement **Funghitastic**.
No minimum level, but the **recommended level is 120** (to do the missions of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} that give the tokens).
The tokens and packages come from the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}, but **you can buy them from other players**: the effect is the same.
Permission to use the {wiki:GCTS|Gnomish Crystal Teleport System}, given by {npc:Xelvar} in Kazordoon at the start of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest} (it is the only way to reach Gnomegate).
for the Gnomish Voucher Type MB (base outfit)
for the Gnomish Voucher Type MA1 (addon 1)
as many as needed until the Gnomish Voucher Type MA2 (addon 2) drops
one to enter and another to leave the GCTS on each visit to Gnomegate
If you do not want to do the Bigfoot's Burden missions, buy the vouchers, tokens or packages from other players — it works exactly the same.
The only dangers are the creatures of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}, and only if you collect the tokens yourself.

{wiki:Gnomegate|Gnomegate} can only be reached through the {wiki:GCTS|GCTS}. In **Kazordoon**, step into the teleport **east** of {npc:Xelvar}, next to the northern blesser (it uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal}). You appear in the GCTS, above the Gnomebase: go down to Gnomegate. {npc:Gnomally} is in the **north** of Gnomegate. There are also GCTS teleports in Thais (Ancient Temple), Darashia, Edron, Liberty Bay and Svargrond.

Collect 20 {item:Major Crystalline Token|Major Crystalline Tokens} (missions of the {wiki:Bigfoot's Burden Quest}) and trade them with {npc:Gnomally}, in **Gnomegate**, for a {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MB} (open the trade with {key:hi} and {key:trade}).
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MB} to receive the **Soil Guardian** outfit.
Collect 70 {item:Minor Crystalline Token|Minor Crystalline Tokens} and trade them with {npc:Gnomally} for a {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MA1}.

To leave, go up to the GCTS (the teleport room above the Gnomebase, where {npc:Gnomette} is) and step into the teleport of the city you want to go to: **Thais** (Ancient Temple), **Darashia** (mountain northwest of the city), **Edron** (sewers), **Kazordoon** (next to the northern blesser), **Liberty Bay** (mountains to the southeast) or **Svargrond** (hole next to the west exit). It uses up a {item:Teleport Crystal}. If you have to return to Gnomally on another day, repeat the "Get to Gnomegate" step.
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MA1} to receive the first addon (cape).
Use {item:Gnomish Supply Package|Gnomish Supply Packages} (also from the Bigfoot's Burden Quest). Each package has a **small chance** of giving the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MA2}.
Since the chance is low, it may be worth buying the voucher directly from another player.
Use the {item:Gnomish Voucher Type MA2} to receive the second addon (shield).
